examples.en: Chick peas have a distinctive, delicious, and nutty flavour.
examples.zh: 鹰嘴豆有独特可口的坚果味。

examples.en: When Miles Davis died jazz was robbed of its most distinctive voice.
examples.zh: 当迈尔斯•戴维斯去世时，爵士乐里最具特色的声音也被夺走了。

examples.en: They have big eyes and distinctive visual centers.
examples.zh: 它们的眼睛很大，有独特的视觉中心。
